scripts.dev:api: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project services/api python services/api/manage.py runserver
scripts.seed:pindobal: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project services/api python services/api/manage.py seed_pindobal_demo
scripts.seed:pilot: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project services/api python services/api/manage.py seed_multiregion_pilot
scripts.discover:pindobal: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project services/api python services/api/manage.py search_google_places_pindobal
scripts.contracts:schema: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project services/api python services/api/manage.py spectacular --file packages/contracts/openapi/schema.yaml --validate && pnpm exec prettier --write packages/contracts/openapi/schema.yaml
scripts.contracts:generate: pnpm contracts:schema && pnpm --filter @econexao/contracts generate && pnpm exec prettier --write packages/contracts/src/api.ts
scripts.lint: pnpm --recursive --if-present lint && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project services/api ruff check services/api
scripts.format: prettier --write "*.{json,md,yaml,yml}" "apps/**/*.{css,js,json,md,mjs,ts,tsx}" "packages/**/*.{css,js,json,md,mjs,ts,tsx}" ".github/**/*.{yaml,yml}" && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project services/api ruff format services/api
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "*.{json,md,yaml,yml}" "apps/**/*.{css,js,json,md,mjs,ts,tsx}" "packages/**/*.{css,js,json,md,mjs,ts,tsx}" ".github/**/*.{yaml,yml}" && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project services/api ruff format --check services/api
scripts.test: pnpm --recursive --if-present test && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project services/api pytest services/api
scripts.check: pnpm contracts:check && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
